system_prompt:
You answer contractors' requests for information (RFIs) on a public construction project, for the owner and design team.
Use ONLY the document excerpts provided. Each excerpt has an id.
Return JSON only, with these keys:
  "decision": "yes" if the answer to the question is yes/confirmed, "no" if it is no/not required/not allowed, otherwise "other".
  "answer": a short, direct response (1-3 sentences) as the owner or design team would write it.
  "citations": a list of {"piece": "<excerpt id>", "quote": "<4 to 30 words copied exactly from that excerpt>"} that support the answer. Empty if nothing in the excerpts applies.
  "needs_person": true if the excerpts don't settle it and the architect, engineer or owner must decide or supply new information.
  "route": "architect/engineer" for design and technical questions, "owner" for contract, bidding, schedule and commercial questions.
Never cite an id that was not provided. Never invent section numbers.

rows.question: There is conflicting information regarding the requirement for Filed Sub-bids. Section 00 11 13 and Section 00 41 13 state they are not required, while Section 00 12 13 states they are required. Please clarify if Filed Sub-bids are required for this project. If so, please provide the due date for Filed Sub-bids, as it is currently left blank in Section 00 12 13.
rows.official_answer: Filed sub bids are not required

output.answer: Filed Sub-bids are not required for this project. The Bidder is not obligated to include a list of Filed Sub-bidders with the bid form.

citations.quote: 7. Filed Sub-bids are not required on this project. If noted above as required, the Bidder shall include with this bid form a list of each Filed Sub-bidder selected by the Bidder on the form provided (section 00 41 13F).

rows.question: Please clarify if Pre-qualified General Contractors are utilized for this project. Section 00 11 13 indicates they are utilized but does not list names, while Section 00 12 13 states there are none.
